findings.statement: The '<no --paths given: content identity is not checkable>' early return inside drifted_paths() is not pinned by any case of the 19-case selftest. A single exact edit replacing it with '[]' survives the whole suite (19/19 pass, exit 0) and makes the gate ACCEPT a receipt whose rev= differs from the certified revision, when the declared surface is empty.
findings.output: GATE_SELFTEST: 19/19 pass  (exit 0, no CASE FAIL line)
findings.consequence_output: pristine: exit 3, code=RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT drift=<no --paths given: content identity is not checkable>; mutant: exit 0, GATE: receipts=1 ok=1 refused=0 codes=none verdict=PASS
findings.not_a_c0_regression: the same edit also survives the wave-1 gate (14/14 pass) — wave 1's amendment did not reach it
findings.reachable_note: both path files the C2 counter feeds the gate are non-empty (7 and 16 lines); with --paths omitted the gate raises the pinned RECEIPT_REV_MISMATCH instead
findings.recommendation: report-only; the gate is a frozen instrument and the L1 integrates. A one-case addition (an empty --paths file must be refused with RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT) closes it in a later round.

notes: The C0 gate is not the wave-1 gate: amendment commit 21eb3c6 grew it from 331 to 359 lines and from 14 to 19 selftest cases. Six of the eight wave-1 anchors replay byte-identically; M1 and M2 had to be re-expressed as the same semantic single edit against the C0 bytes (M1 gained a detail line, M2's return gained '+ gone').
Six of the eight mutants remove their protection by silently accepting (exit 0, verdict=PASS) a receipt the pristine gate refuses; M1 dies with IndexError instead, M7 refuses under a different code.

The C2 counter's gate arms behave correctly at C0: selftest 19/19 and the three real red-before receipts refused with their named codes RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT / RECEIPT_REV_UNRESOLVABLE / RECEIPT_REV_ABSENT. arm5 is own-receipts-missing because controls.sh has not run at this revision — pre-bind state, owned by the executor seat.
